answer: Trellis Delta-Ladder Bond. Each identity climbs the trellis: first rung costs 36 credits, delta 7 per rung, thousandth pays 7,029. Each paid rung leaves a one-key walnut receipt on the trellis; a rung without its walnut is refused. The first-to-thousandth gap is 6,993: 1,000 fakes cost 3,532,500 against a 40,000 pool. A rented walnut bears its owner's key; reuse burns the bond. An honest agent climbs one rung, pays 36 once, keeps its reward.
